summary: Iteration 2: verified critical AI bug fix (distinct, non-mock generations), and new features (Idea Comparison, Viva Prep Mode). Ran 3 regression + 10 new backend tests (all pass) and full frontend flow (login → generate → compare → details → chat → viva → refine → save/favorites/history/delete → admin → google fallback → registration). Found one UI crash in ProjectCard when legacy DB records have dict-shaped tech_stack; added a defensive guard on frontend to prevent the crash on /history and /favorites.

minor.issue: Returns legacy documents with tech_stack as a dict (not the normalized list). Only the generate path normalizes; stored older docs still have dict tech_stack which broke ProjectCard rendering. Recommend a one-time backfill or normalize in the GET response.

ui_bugs.issue: Crash 'project.tech_stack.slice is not a function' when tech_stack is a dict (legacy records). Guarded with Array.isArray fallback; main agent should still fix underlying data.

issues: React dev warning: <option> children include a <span> wrapper injected by the editor overlay causing 'Cannot infer the option value of complex children' warning. Cosmetic only in prod.

action_items: Optional: backfill or normalize tech_stack on read for legacy projects (backend GET /api/projects) so any client (mobile/pdf) stays safe.
Nice-to-have: return AI-derived popular branches from real data in /api/admin/stats instead of the static 42/28/24 list.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_text semaphore + retry with backoff is a correct fix for the 429/mock leak bug; verified end-to-end (two distinct interests produce topic-specific, non-mock, disjoint titles).
generate route normalizes dict tech_stack for new docs but old docs remain broken and crash ProjectCard until frontend guard was added.
The favorites 'Ready when you are' fallback shows a hardcoded '4' when saved.length is 0; consider showing the real 0 to avoid misleading users.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/App.js (added Array.isArray guard for project.tech_stack in ProjectCard tag row)
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ admin-owned projects via generate (bug-verification for IoT and AI/ML interests) and one registered TEST_ student user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'same generic results' is FIXED — verified topic-specific, distinct outputs for 'smart farming drones' vs 'stock market prediction'. Improve idea, Ask mentor, Viva Prep, Compare (dashboard + history), Save/Favorites/History/Delete, Admin stats, Google managed redirect + invalid-session fallback, and Registration all work in the UI. The added frontend guard shields against legacy dict-shaped tech_stack; underlying data cleanup is optional.
rca of the issue: ProjectCard crashed on history/favorites because pre-fix records were persisted with tech_stack as a dict returned by the LLM. Current generate route normalizes on write, but existing docs still had dict shape. Fixed on the client with Array.isArray check that falls back to Object.values.
